source_text: Οὐκοῦν ὃς μὴ ἅγιος ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ εἰ μὴ προαγνίζοιτο, καθ' ὃν ἂν πρέπει τρόπον, ἀποχωρείτω μακράν· νηποινὶ γὰρ οὐχὶ τῶν θείων ἅψεται θυσιαστηρίων.
pass_a_gloss: [Cyril, continuing] Therefore whoever is not holy in Christ and if he should not purify beforehand in whatever manner is fitting, let him withdraw far; for not with impunity will he touch the divine altars.
pass_b_english: Cyril: So then, whoever is not holy in Christ and does not first purify himself in the way that is fitting, let him keep far away; for he will not touch the divine altars without punishment.
